usage.summary: `good-dropdown` combines a GoodUI Button trigger with a structured popup. The trigger inherits Button's `variant`, `size`, leading `icon`, disabled state, and focus style. Set `showChevron` to hide the trailing chevron; an icon-only trigger needs an `ariaLabel`. The popup owns its placement, header, item list, footer, scrolling, and submenus, so consuming apps do not need positioning CSS.
